newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise on fresh consumer demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise on fresh consumer demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Monday rose on fresh consumer demand and renewed inquiries from retailers ahead of the wedding season, dealers said.
In ready delivery sugar S30 rose by 5/6 rupees to 1,245/1,281 while sugar M30 rose by the same margin at 1,265/1,319 rupees.
Local millers are witnessing higher demand from neighbouring states which in turn curtailed supplies of sugar from mills to the local market, dealers said.
Sugar mill delivery rose to 1,180/1,205 rupees from 1,170/1,180. Overall market sentiment was firm at the close.
